card: One Director call pipeline: harness, CampNight and Parley share source resolution
guards: camp-night.test.ts existing 6 cases (incl. 'seals partial groups, aborts transport and ignores late cache writes', renamed cache-reuse case)
director.test.ts W0 golden oracle + full-season planner replay
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: resolveCall takes planner:{tables,state,group,members} and calls plan(tables,state,id,false,draws) itself; CampNight passes its own tables (remainingCaps) and dusk state, PlannerProvider.decide is never called (test asserts it, with a provider whose state() throws). Harness passes no planner option, so it still answers via provider.decide (unchanged draws path). CampNight draws are kept in a new CampNight.plannerDraws Map (not checkpointed: save-schema nightAudit is strict). Commit series follows the card's rollback (1: inert call.ts+call.test.ts+index export, 2: migrate) rather than a red test-only commit. Cases 1/4/5/6 got companion cases (1b decide-path planner, 4b forceLive, 5b validated record cached, 6b throwing provider) = 10 in call.test.ts + 2 in camp-night.test.ts (cases 7, 8). On abort, resolveCall returns source 'aborted' with the provider result intact and no cache write; CampNight discards it, Parley maps it back to 'live' with error timeout/cancelled as before.
